question:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank:

The teacher ______ the students to think critically about the topic.
solution:
The correct answer is '**Option 3**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word "**advised**" means to give suggestions or recommendations to someone. (सलाह देना)
 
• In the context of the sentence, the teacher advised the students to think critically, which is most appropriate.
 
• The other options: "**acquiesced**," "**admonished**," and "**asserted**" do not fit the context as accurately.

​Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 3**'.

**Complete Sentence:** *The teacher advised__ the students to think critically about the topic.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Acquiesced (मौन स्वीकृति):** means to accept something reluctantly but without protest.
 
• **Admonished (डांटना):** means to warn or reprimand someone firmly.
 
• **Asserted (जोर देना):** means to state a fact or belief confidently and forcefully.

32:Tb85,

The correct answer is: Option 2</b
